bannerText: Todijo uses necessary cookies and browser storage for secure accounts, language, cart and checkout. Optional categories stay off unless you choose them.
preferencesIntro: Choose optional storage. Necessary technology stays active.
essentialText: Required for security, sign-in, language, cart, consent choices and requested checkout.
preferencesText: No preference storage currently requires consent. This control is ready for future optional features.
analyticsText: No analytics tracker is currently installed.
marketingText: No advertising tracker is currently installed.
privacyPolicyIntro: How Todijo processes information for its multi-vendor marketplace.
policyBody: Depending on your use, Todijo processes account and buyer/seller profiles, stores and products, messages, reviews, orders, delivery and refund evidence, support communications, security records and technical logs to provide and secure the service, process orders, prevent abuse and meet record-keeping duties. Stripe handles payment and onboarding; Todijo does not receive full card details. Cloudflare Turnstile supports registration security, Cloudinary hosts seller images, R2-compatible storage holds refund evidence, and an SMTP provider sends service email. Data is retained only as needed for service, security, disputes, accounting and legal duties. Provider locations, transfer safeguards, exact retention schedules and legal bases must be verified by the owner.
cookiePolicyIntro: Current browser technologies: todijo_session (secure sign-in, 7 days), TODIJO_LOCALE (language, 12 months), todijo-consent-v1 (choices, 6 months), cart and pending-checkout storage (requested service), and account-isolated favorites (preference). Stripe and Turnstile load only for requested payment or security functions. No analytics or advertising tracker is installed.
privacyDataIntro: Request information, access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection, or withdraw consent. Automated export and immediate hard deletion are not currently offered.
rightsBody: Use Todijo's contact path for a rights, export or deletion request. Todijo will assess safe deletion, deactivation or anonymisation while retaining transaction records required for orders, disputes, accounting or law. You may complain to the competent supervisory authority.
identityText: Todijo operates this multi-vendor marketplace. The operator's verified legal identity, registration details, postal address and dedicated privacy contact are not established in the repository and must be supplied by the owner before the legal notice is final.
dataText: Todijo processes account details such as name, email, password hash, verification status and account role; buyer and seller profiles; store contact, location and presentation details; product listings and images; messages and reviews; order, recipient, delivery, fulfillment, issue and refund-evidence information; support communications; and security or technical logs needed to operate and protect the service.
marketplaceText: Todijo uses order and seller information to create, confirm, fulfill and support marketplace transactions. Stripe processes checkout, payment confirmation, seller onboarding, subscriptions and payouts where applicable. Todijo stores Stripe identifiers and status information needed to reconcile transactions, but does not receive full payment-card details.
purposesText: Information is used to create and secure accounts, verify registration, operate stores and listings, provide carts and favorites, enable buyer-seller messages and reviews, process and support orders, investigate issues and refunds, prevent abuse or fraud, send service emails, maintain technical reliability and respond to support or privacy requests. The owner must confirm the applicable legal basis for each activity.
providersText: Repository evidence identifies Stripe for payments and seller services, Cloudflare Turnstile for registration security, Cloudinary for seller and product images, Cloudflare R2-compatible object storage for refund evidence, and an SMTP provider for service emails. Information is disclosed only as needed for the requested service, security, dispute handling or legal obligations. Provider locations, contracts and any international-transfer safeguards require owner verification.
retentionText: Information is kept only while needed to provide the service, secure accounts, maintain transaction history, resolve disputes and meet applicable accounting or legal obligations. Retention depends on the data and context; no unsupported fixed period is claimed. Deletion requests may result in deletion, deactivation or anonymisation while records that must be preserved remain protected.
rightsText: Where the GDPR applies, you may request information and access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability or object to processing. You may withdraw consent at any time where processing relies on consent, without affecting earlier lawful processing. You may also complain to the competent supervisory authority in your place of residence, work or the alleged infringement.
securityText: Todijo uses password hashing, signed HTTP-only session cookies, access controls, signed Stripe webhooks, human-verification controls and restricted evidence access. Necessary cookies and browser storage support sessions, language, cart, checkout reconciliation and consent choices. Optional categories remain off without consent and choices can be changed through Manage cookies.
updatesText: This notice will be updated when Todijo's verified operator details, processing practices or providers materially change. A renewed cookie choice will be requested when a material consent change requires it.
requestText: Use Todijo's existing contact route to submit a privacy, access, correction, portability, objection, restriction, consent-withdrawal or deletion request. Automated export and immediate hard deletion are not currently offered. Todijo must verify the requester and assess records that need to be retained for orders, disputes, accounting or legal obligations.
